mentions.name: ChartDB
mentions.description: An open-source tool to visualize and edit database schemas, supporting Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL, and ClickHouse. Includes an AI export feature to generate DDL in any SQL dialect.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We’re building ChartDB - an open-source tool to visualize and edit your database schema.

Supports Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL, ClickHouse. Includes AI export to generate DDL in any SQL dialect.
